build_name: ETRANOM V2167 — Stage 25 Comprehensive Geometry & Physics Repair
known_limitations: Canvas/SVG isometric architecture remains 2.5D, not a general 3D engine.
Bridge solver has no general mesh-to-mesh contact manifold or multibody joint constraints.
Snow collision meshes are exported and share deformed vertices with rendering, but are not wired into a world-wide general mesh collision solver.
Interior navigation and character movement remain plane-based per active floor.
Vehicle model is game-oriented and not a full engineering tyre/vehicle simulation.
91 broader legacy test failures remain across 44 test files.
No live browser, Android device or production backend verification was run.
